findings.title: Auto display units scale every cell by the grand-total magnitude with 0 decimals — values collapse to 0M and lose their sign
findings.expected: Cell values stay readable and faithful (native matrix shows full values; at minimum a non-zero value never renders as 0 and a negative never loses its sign)
findings.actual: Nulls page: Alpha 320,000 → '0M', Echo 275,000 → '0M', Variance -18,000 → '0M'. Huge 10k page: every row '0M' (total 50M). Nominal 3rd instance: 355,000 → '0M'. The scale is chosen from computeMaxAbs over ALL rows (grand total included) and applied to every measure column with 0 decimals
repro: Open audit/test-report, page 'Nulls' (Values card left at defaults: display units Auto, decimals 0)
Read the Sum of Actual / Sum of Variance cells
findings.fixHint: In a grid, 'auto' units must not rescale cells to a magnitude where they round to 0 — default to no scaling (native matrix parity) or derive the scale per column without the totals and keep enough decimals

findings.title: First measure's column header is blank whenever the tree header path is used
findings.expected: Every measure column carries its measure name (as on the IBCS pages, where the flat header path is used)
findings.actual: Header empty over the first value column on Interactions ('Actual'), Formats ('Total Actual'), Nulls / Negatives / Hostile labels / Huge 10k ('Sum of Actual'), One row and Two rows. Second and later measures are labelled. The IBCS template pages are unaffected because templates force the flat header
repro: Open page 'Formats' (3 measures, no column field)
Look at the header above the first value column
findings.fixHint: The host omits levelSourceIndex when it is 0 — treat a measure-level leaf with undefined levelSourceIndex as measure 0 (and add a harness case where the first measure node has no levelSourceIndex)

findings.title: In-visual ✎ / 💬 toolbar is drawn over the grid and hides header text and data values
findings.expected: Visual chrome never overlaps data (Microsoft: elements positioned in accord with the rest of the visual)
findings.actual: The absolutely-positioned toolbar (top:4px; right:4px) covers the last column header on every page ('ΔPL %' clipped on the four IBCS pages) and the first data cell when the grid is narrow: One row shows Total '5' instead of 500K, Two rows '7' instead of 750K, Tiny '6' instead of 6M
repro: Open page 'Multi-instance'
Read the Total row of 'One row' and 'Two rows'
findings.fixHint: Reserve space for the toolbar (or reveal it only on hover/focus and outside the cell area) so it never sits on top of header or value text

findings.title: Row subtotals default to 'Top': grand total renders first, and each hierarchy group renders an empty header row followed by a separate 'Total' row
findings.expected: Out-of-the-box layout matches the native matrix (row subtotals at the bottom; with 'Top', the subtotal values sit on the group row itself)
findings.actual: Every page shows 'Total' as the first row. On 'Nominal' (Segment > Country) each segment shows a blank group row, then a 'Total' row, then its countries — two rows per group for one piece of information. On IBCS T04 the result bar is drawn before the cascade it closes
repro: Open page 'Nominal'
Observe the Channel Partners group: blank row, 'Total' row, then countries
findings.fixHint: Default rowSubtotalsType to 'Bottom' in capabilities AND settings together (keep all six switch mappings — CLAUDE.md), and for 'Top' fold the subtotal values onto the group header row

findings.title: IBCS bars and pins: total and subtotal rows saturate at the full half-track
findings.expected: Bar length is proportional to the value on every row, or totals use their own scale
findings.actual: T02: Total ΔPY -9,742,264 is drawn exactly as long as France -3,513,983 (the domain is computed over detail rows only, totals are clamped to 100 %)
repro: Open page 'IBCS T02'
Compare the Total ΔPY bar with the France ΔPY bar
findings.fixHint: Include subtotal rows in the bar/pin domain, or give totals a separate scale

findings.title: Pane icon is the Eclor Waterfall icon
findings.expected: A matrix-specific 20×20 RGBA icon (CLAUDE.md gotcha: replace before Stage B)
findings.actual: assets/icon.png is 20×20 RGBA but byte-identical to eclor-waterfall/assets/icon.png (md5 99a8a60f…)
repro: md5sum assets/icon.png ../eclor-waterfall/assets/icon.png
findings.fixHint: Design is the user's call — needs a matrix glyph in the ECLOR style; the fixer should not invent branding

findings.title: No min/max conditions on the matrix mapping
findings.expected: Microsoft case 'Check min/max dataViewMapping conditions': each bucket's cardinality intent encoded
findings.actual: dataViewMappings[0].conditions is absent — every role (including comments) accepts unlimited fields
repro: node -e "console.log(require('./capabilities.json').dataViewMappings[0].conditions)"
findings.fixHint: Declare explicit conditions matching the intended cardinality (single mapping only — never a second mapping, CLAUDE.md)

findings.title: Custom column widths can only be set with the mouse
findings.expected: Every interactive feature reachable from the keyboard
findings.actual: Column grips are aria-hidden spans without tabindex; no keyboard path or Format-pane equivalent for individual widths
repro: Columns widths → Custom
Try to resize a column without a mouse
findings.fixHint: Make the grip focusable with arrow-key resizing, or expose per-column widths elsewhere

findings.title: T04 waterfall cursor is not re-anchored between groups of a multi-level hierarchy
findings.expected: Each group's cascade connects to its own subtotal bar
findings.actual: waterfallStarts keeps one running cursor across groups while subtotal bars start at 0, so group N's detail bars start where group N-1 ended (single-level schemes such as the T04 page are correct)
repro: T04 template, Rows = Segment > Country
Compare the second segment's last detail bar end with its subtotal bar end
findings.fixHint: Reset or rebase the cursor at each group boundary so the cascade and subtotal agree

findings.title: 'Blank column between groups' flattens the multi-level column header
findings.expected: Aeration columns keep the hierarchical header
findings.actual: buildRenderColumns returns a flat header as soon as gap columns are on, even without calc columns
repro: Columns = Year > Quarter, 2 measures
Grid & borders → Blank column between groups ON
findings.fixHint: Insert gap cells into the tree header rows instead of switching to the flat header

findings.title: Format-pane options are not localized (only card titles have displayNameKey)
findings.expected: Per project policy — eclor-waterfall shipped certified with English slice labels BY DESIGN, but eclor-matrix CLAUDE.md does not document that posture
findings.actual: 12 displayNameKey for 105 cards/slices; a French Desktop shows French card titles over English options
repro: grep -c displayNameKey src/settings.ts
findings.fixHint: Decision needed: adopt the waterfall posture (document it in CLAUDE.md) or add keys + fr/en strings for every slice

findings.title: supportsHighlight is not declared
findings.expected: Checklist expects the four cert flags; Microsoft only requires that selections in other visuals filter this one
findings.actual: Flag absent; the host therefore filters the matrix on cross-selection (GEN-04 verified working — same behaviour as the native matrix)
repro: Interactions page: click 'Government' in the bar chart
findings.fixHint: Decision needed: keep filter semantics (document why) or implement highlight rendering before declaring the flag

findings.title: Column grip tooltip is hard-coded English
findings.expected: User-facing runtime strings go through the localization manager (36 other chrome strings do)
findings.actual: 'Drag to resize · double-click to reset' is a literal
repro: French Desktop, Column widths → Custom, hover a grip
findings.fixHint: Route through this.localize with en/fr resjson keys

findings.title: No jest case for a measure bound to several roles at once
findings.expected: Playbook §4.3.2 role-iteration test: the same measure in Values + Tooltips (+ Comments) renders once in the grid and once in the tooltip
findings.actual: lifecycle.test.ts covers tooltip-only measures, not a measure carrying values AND tooltips/comments roles
repro: grep for a values+tooltips dual-role fixture in test/
findings.fixHint: Add the dual-role fixture; also add one where the first measure node has no levelSourceIndex (see GEN-25-a)

findings.title: certification branch lags main (1.6.0.0 vs 1.11.1.0)
findings.expected: certification matches the build that will be submitted
findings.actual: origin/certification = 81796d4 (1.6.0.0); main = 762d9e0 (1.11.1.0). Not blocking before submission
repro: git log --oneline -1 origin/certification
findings.fixHint: Fast-forward certification once the audit loop reaches READY
